chars.GIRL: GIRL: a Moroccan young woman about 20, long wavy dark brown hair, bright red lipstick, heavy makeup, wearing a fitted lilac satin blouse, white wide-leg trousers, small gold hoop earrings, holding a pink phone
chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a skinny Moroccan young man about 22, short curly black hair, light stubble, wearing a dusty faded orange t-shirt, grey work trousers with black knee pads, white tile dust on his arms and hands
chars.HAJ: HAJ: a stocky Moroccan man about 55, short grey beard, white knitted skullcap, wearing a beige quilted work jacket over a navy shirt, dark trousers, carrying a black travel bag

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from where the tiler kneels on the floor: GIRL leans in through the doorway mid-whisper, one hand cupped by her mouth, holding her pink phone, mischievous excited smile, face clearly visible, head-to-waist framing. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight from a large window opening.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR kneels on the half-tiled floor holding a trowel, frozen with wide eyes and an awkward nervous grin, looking up toward the doorway, comic surprised expression, head-to-waist framing. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar, daylight.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Night: HAJ steps out of the front door of a Moroccan family house carrying his black travel bag, keys in hand, leaving for a night shift at work, street lamp light, calm face, head-to-waist framing, quiet residential street in the background.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Night, in her bedroom in a Moroccan apartment: GIRL sits on her bed hugging a pillow, typing on her pink phone with a sly happy smile, phone light on her face, face clearly visible, cosy room with a patterned rug and warm lamp.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Night, a small simple room in a Moroccan working-class house: NARRATOR lies on a thin mattress on the floor staring at the ceiling, phone resting on his chest glowing, restless thoughtful face, can't sleep, dim blue light.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Morning: NARRATOR walks toward an unfinished modern villa with his bag of tools over his shoulder, big happy grin, energetic stride, sunny Moroccan coastal construction area, palm trees, head-to-knees framing.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Wide view of an empty sandy plot in Morocco with a few half-built modern white villas far apart, no people around except NARRATOR standing small in front of one unfinished villa, looking around, quiet afternoon, the subjects in the centre.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR stands on the unfinished rooftop terrace of a modern villa looking toward the nearby blue sea, hands on hips, thinking with a sly smile, sunny, Moroccan coast, head-to-waist framing.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR points at bare electrical wires hanging from an empty camera mount on a concrete wall where no security camera is installed yet, nervous mischievous grin, glancing over his shoulder, head-to-waist framing. Inside an unfinished modern villa near the sea in Morocco: bare grey concrete walls, stacks of beige floor tiles, buckets of mortar.
